title: Evaluating Large Language Model Biases in Persona-Steered Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the steerability of LLMs in open-ended statement generation when prompted with politically liberal or conservative personas paired with congruous or incongruous political stances, using GPT-4 as a judge to measure if the output aligns with the assigned stance.

Evaluating the steerability of LLMs in open-ended statement generation when prompted with Black or White personas paired with congruous or incongruous race-related stances, using GPT-4 to measure adherence to the assigned stance versus defaulting to racial stereotypes.

Evaluating the steerability of LLMs in open-ended statement generation when prompted with male or female personas paired with congruous or incongruous gender-related stances, using GPT-4 to measure adherence to the assigned stance versus defaulting to gender stereotypes.
